tools.name: critique_experience
tools.description: Adversarial critique of a design, given as a description or a screenshot URL, with an optional PRD. Returns findings ranked by severity covering hierarchy, density, affordance, composition, copy, and the first-use / 500th-use / zero-data / huge-data / no-permission / irreversible questions. Call it

tools.name: generate_state_matrix
tools.description: Generates the state space for a feature, form or screen across data, loading, permission, network, account, content, time, concurrency, outside dependencies, money, consistency and people, and lists the gaps most likely to cause real harm. Call it when a feature is described and you want to know wha

tools.name: map_journey
tools.description: Breaks a user objective into the stages of a real journey and flags entry points and exit paths that have no designed arrival or recovery. Optionally focuses on one user maturity (first use, occasional, habitual, expert). Describes behavior, not screens.

tools.name: audit_copy
tools.description: Per-string critique of interface copy: buttons, errors, empty states, confirmations, notifications. Each string comes back with the problem and a fix, or nothing if it already works. Call it before shipping UI strings.

tools.name: find_assumptions
tools.description: Reads a PRD or design brief and extracts the unverified assumptions inside it, ranked by risk, each turned into a research question that could change a decision. Never simulates user answers.

tools.name: check_terminology
tools.description: Finds concepts that carry different names across surfaces (UI strings, docs, API reference, support macros) and flags drift. Pass the text from each surface; nothing needs connecting.
